luiskr.com / website/components/media/expanded/genie-texture / buildGenieSheet

function buildGenieSheet(content, dpr): GenieSheet | null

Defined in: website/components/media/expanded/genie-texture.ts:223

Bakes the bounded modal card into an offscreen canvas — the sheet the genie funnel warps. The extent is the media-figure rect (the "window" — reference-faithful): its opaque frame, rounded clip, placeholder and media item, all figure-local. The fullscreen glass veil and viewport chrome stay out of the texture and fade under .expand-modal-genie-veil while the funnel flies. One layout pass (batched rect + style reads), one canvas, ~a dozen draw calls; the result is a stable texture so the per-frame work stays a pure strip resample. The texture long edge caps at GENIE_WARP.TEX_MAX_PX — enough sharpness for a 700ms warp without an unbounded framebuffer.

Parameters

content

HTMLElement

The modal content root (the figure lives inside it).

dpr

number

The overlay's device-pixel cap (already clamped).

Returns

GenieSheet | null

The sheet record, or null when the card has no box or the canvas refuses a 2D context (the warp then ghosts).
